about: A person's own days under repeating orders (spec/shift-patterns.md, Repeating orders): only what differs from the order is kept as theirs. edited: `planned` is the orders' shift by date; the days show as `own` over it, and an edit sets the days in `edits` (null clears one) to give the person's own days `expected`. A day showing its planned shift keeps no shift of its own (a memo or people stay); clearing a day the order fills keeps "" (dayRules.noShift); a day the edit does not touch stays as it was. givenToOrder: starting an order, or correcting the one in use, on `start` gives the days from then back to it: their own shifts and times go, memos and people stay; days before it stay as they were.

edited.name: a memo on a day the order fills keeps no shift of its own
another shift is kept, and clearing a day keeps an empty one
entering the order's own shift again gives the day back to it
days the edit does not touch stay as they were
clearing a day no order fills leaves nothing

givenToOrder.name: a new order takes shifts and times from its start, not memos
